summary: Return own enumerable string-keyed [key,value] pairs in ECMAScript property order.

semantics.keys: own enumerable strings only; Symbols omitted
semantics.order: integer-index keys ascending, then other strings in creation order
semantics.getters: values are read with Get and may invoke getters

caveats: Dictionary iteration order is not a sufficient language-level guarantee for ECMAScript key ordering.
Proxy ownKeys/getOwnPropertyDescriptor traps require runtime fallback.

tests.name: symbols omitted and getter invoked
tests.input: let n=0; const s=Symbol(); const x={[s]:1,get a(){n++;return 2}}; console.log(Object.entries(x)[0][1],n);
